skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Phototaxis
skins.content: Iteration Provident/Phototaxis. Ascalon's iteration from decision point F/3019226. She bids it stay for the sake of the lives of countless unbelievers, but the Seventh Sun is still determined to fall.
skins.quote: 'I once danced, chasing the flame, but they feared me, and ultimately abandoned me. They have forgotten what sort of power hides in the dark. Come with me. If this thousand years without night has an end, I will cut down each and every sun myself.'
